result:
Enemies now flash white when hit: `hit()` in `scripts/enemy.gd` sets the `amount` uniform to 1 on the enemy's own `flash.gdshader` material and tweens it to 0 over 0.2 seconds.

I gave each enemy its own `ShaderMaterial` in `_ready()`, so only the hit enemy flashes. I also made a killing hit wait for the flash to finish before `queue_free()`, so the flash is visible on death; that delays the removal by 0.2 seconds. Godot isn't installed here, so I haven't run the game.
